An '''assault platoon''',<ref name="ISB" /> also known as a '''heavy weapons platoon''',<ref name="ISB2" /> was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Assault platoons were made up of two [[line squad]]s, and two [[heavy weapons squad]]s, usually armed with [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blasters]]. Assault platoons were commonly strengthened by the addition of one or more [[heavy weapons detail]], such as a [[heavy repeating blaster detail]] or [[medium repeating blaster detail]]. A standard assault platoon numbered between thirty-eight to forty-seven men, with forty-one being the most commonly encountered size.<ref name="ISB" /> Assault platoons could be augmented by the addition of two [[armor section]]s and two [[line squad]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
